content: To create a microchaptered page, you must first search for the disease name of the page you intend to create. This ensures that the page does not already exist. Additionally, search for synonyms or alternative names of the disease to avoid duplicating content. If the page already exists but is not microchaptered, you can create a new microchaptered page and reorganize the old content into the new format. Only microchapter a page if it exceeds one and a half pages in length and contains sufficient content to be divided into microchapters. Follow the instructions below to create a microchapter template and copy and paste the reorganized information into standardized microchapters. To create a microchapter template, if the disease page does not exist, you will need to create a new microchaptered page. For example, if you are creating a page on jaundice that does not exist, navigate to the WikiDoc Disease Microchapter Template listed under Advanced Editing on the home page. Click the edit tab and copy all the text in the edit box. Then, type Template:Jaundice into the main WikiDoc search box (without quotation marks). Click on the option to create the page Template:Jaundice on this Wiki. Paste the copied microchapter template information into the edit box. At the top of the edit box, there are two blank fields: the top one with binocular icons and the bottom one with red arrows. In the top field, type type page name here, and in the bottom field, type the name of the disease page you are creating. Click the red arrows on the right side of the bottom field and continue clicking until you reach the end of the edit box. This will populate the disease name in all the microchapter navigation boxes, linking them to the appropriate pages. Remove any cells that are not relevant to the disease you are working on. Finally, click save at the bottom of the edit box. You now have a microchapter navigation template that will be inserted into all the microchapter pages you create. To create the microchaptered home page, search for the disease name in the WikiDoc search box. It is advisable to search for synonyms of the disease name to ensure that no similar page already exists. If a similar page exists, you can add new content or incorporate the old content into a new page. For example, for jaundice, search for Jaundice, then click on the option to Create the page Jaundice on this Wiki. In the edit box, type `{{Jaundice}}` and click save at the bottom of the edit box. The main page will display the microchapters listed on the right side. Use the microchapter template in all subsequent microchapter pages you create by typing `{{jaundice}}` into the edit box. This ensures ease of navigation, as users can easily click back to the home page or other microchapter pages regardless of which microchapter page they are viewing. The home page also contains links to the individual microchapter pages in the appropriate order. To do this, type into the edit box of the home page `== ] ==`. On the left side of the vertical line in the brackets is the link to the page, and on the right side is how the link will appear on the page. Ensure that the links on the home page match and are in the same order as the cells in the microchapter navigation template. For more information on creating links, click here. Although the microchapter pages only capitalize the first letter of the heading, the links on the home page may appear differently. Consistency is important, so refer to capitalization and correct nomenclature examples by clicking here. To create the individual pages within a microchaptered page, the home page will display the microchapter navigation template on the right side of the screen and the headings of the microchapters in the middle section of the page, which will also link to the microchapters. To view this on a home page and practice navigating a microchaptered page, click here. As you create new microchapter pages, you will create a link on the home page. To create a new microchapter page, click on the appropriate section within the microchapter navigation template on the home page. Then, click on Create the page _____ on this wiki. Create the page using the appropriate template listed on the main page. Be sure to include the microchapter navigation template `{{jaundice}}` on each microchapter page. For references and sources, if the content for the page is obtained from a general source, such as a website or textbook, list it under a heading at the bottom of the page titled Sources. If the content is obtained from a journal article or another article, list it under a heading at the bottom of the page titled References. For information on how to insert a reference, click here.
